benchmark_environment: x86_64 CPU, Windows 11 host vs WSL2 native
workload: GRI-30 (53 species), 20k forward evals, 2k HP inversions
status_explanation: Pure-Python/NumPy ThermoPhase achieves full scientific parity with exact convergence and bitwise/numerical accuracy across all 90 cases. However, Python interpreter overhead results in a 198.7x slowdown on forward evaluations and 237.7x on Newton state inversions compared to -O3 compiled C++.
